detailed_description:
The target video adopts a cinematic live-action wuxia style with cool blue-silver moonlight, deep crushed shadows, and atmospheric volumetric mist, shot in anamorphic widescreen with shallow depth of field and high-contrast nocturnal grading.

[Shot 1] A static wide establishing shot frames the moonlit shallows of <Subject 1>: a heavy stone arch bridge rises on the right, the full moon glows through drifting thin clouds in the upper center, tall silvered reeds bow on the left bank under a faint breeze, and pale mist hovers half a foot above the shallow stream. Two figures stand knee-deep facing each other near the center of the frame. On the left, <Subject 2>, the young woman with the high black bun, a slim silver hairpin, and silver tassel earrings, holds her weight slightly back on her right leg, her left hand half-raised at shoulder height with fingertips relaxed, her dark robe falling straight around her hips. On the right, <Subject 3>, the young man with short cropped black hair, sharp cheekbones, and faint jawline stubble, mirrors her stance with both palms turned forward at chest level. The camera holds a static composition as a thin veil of mist glides slowly between them, dimpling the water around their calves. At 00:02.500, <Subject 2> shifts forward a fraction and the water around her right ankle dimples into a quick ring; <Subject 3> lowers his center of gravity a half inch in response. The moon casts two long reflections on the stream that converge just behind the fighters.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot at water level, framing both fighters from waist up against the moon and the bridge arch, with shallow depth of field so the background mist pools into a soft silver halo. <Subject 2> surges forward and swings her open right palm in a sharp descending arc aimed at <Subject 3>'s left shoulder; her silver tassel earrings whip horizontal across the air. <Subject 3> turns his torso a quarter circle to the right, deflects her forearm across his left palm, and pivots hard on his left foot. The pivot drives his right heel into the stream and throws a sheet of silver water upward that crosses the lens and briefly obscures the frame. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as <Subject 2> recovers by planting her right foot deep into the riverbed, her black robe flaring outward at the hem; she counters with a rising left elbow aimed at his jaw. <Subject 3> ducks cleanly under the elbow, drops his center, and drives his right fist in a low straight line toward her midsection. <Subject 2> reads the strike, pulls her hip half a step back, and catches his incoming wrist against her right forearm. The clinch holds for one held breath at 00:07.500, mist curling off their sleeves and droplets still falling from the rebound of the splash; then both fighters push off each other with a synchronized shove and slide a step apart over the smooth wet stones, the reeds behind them bending from the wash of their movement.

[Shot 3] At 00:09.500, the camera cuts to a tight medium two-shot of <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> from chest up, framed dead-on so the bright moon is centered exactly between their heads. <Subject 2> stands with her right forearm crossed in front of her face in a closed guard, the silver hairpin catching a thin sliver of moonlight; her dark eyes lock forward, her expression unreadable. <Subject 3> stands at arm's length across from her, his left palm open at shoulder height and his right hand cocked low near his ribs, fingers slightly spread. The camera holds a static shot as a low sheet of mist rolls across their feet and the water surface around them relaxes into a series of concentric ripples that mirror the moon. The two fighters remain frozen in this standoff, two dark silhouettes against the pale silver disc, until the final frame at 12.00.

overall_soundscape:
Water laps softly against the smooth river stones while tall reeds bow in a faint breeze across the shallows. Footfalls and pivots splash the shallow stream with crisp impacts, sleeves brush the air with low fabric sighs, and a hush of controlled breath carries through the clinch. Distant wind over the moat and the soft hush of drifting mist complete the nighttime quiet.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained dizi and erhu duet at a slow tempo, with sustained low strings underneath that swell slightly through the clash in [Shot 2] and fade to a single held erhu note at the final standoff in [Shot 3].
